title: 🔮 PRISM claim registry value
description: Schema for the value stored at custom_store key prism:claim:<rox_person_id>, org-scoped. One claim per person; alternates are never claimed. See design-spec.md §6.3.

claim_status.description: State machine: (no claim) -> CLAIMED (11b) -> SEQUENCE_CREATED (11f), or CLAIMED -> RELEASED on 11c-11f failure (11g). RELEASED is terminal and treated as 'no claim' going forward.

sequence_campaign_id.description: Set at 11f once the paused sequence exists. Null before then.

sequence_status.description: Null until claim_status is SEQUENCE_CREATED, then starts at PAUSED. PRISM itself only ever writes PAUSED; other values are readable but written by a future sequence-lifecycle companion workflow (design-spec.md §12).

fresh_catch_report_id.description: Echoes the triggering payload's report_id, for lineage.

pursuit_id.description: The primary candidate's pursuit_id (not an alternate's).

error_reason.description: Present only when claim_status is RELEASED via the 11g failure path. Free-text error identifier, e.g. create_email_template_failed:wave1.
